Narrator.TajemnicePlaceholder: Enter secrets, mysteries, and plot hooks here...

Przyjaciele.ZwOpis: When you spend time with your pet, you can shift one marked Condition to another one.
Przyjaciele.Opis: When someone is your Friend or Rival, you may add +1 to a roll to help or hinder them. You can be Friends or Rivals with other players or with Narrator characters. You may only add or remove a Friend or Rival at the end of a session. You can have up to 2 Friends and 1 Rival at a time.

Conditions.PrzestraszonyOpis: (-2 to Bravery until you avoid something difficult.)
Conditions.ZlyOpis: (-2 to Cunning until you hurt someone or break something.)
Conditions.ZestresowanyOpis: (-2 to Intellect until you say something hurtful to someone.)
Conditions.ZazdrosnyOpis: (-2 to Loyalty until you betray a friend.)
Conditions.ZawstydzonyOpis: (-2 to Magic until you take a comment the wrong way.)
Conditions.RannyOpis: (-1 to all traits until healed with medicine or magic.)
Conditions.PrzekletyOpis: (-1 to 1 trait of the Narrator’s choice until cured.)
Conditions.NieprzytomnyOpis: (Unable to act until revived, can avoid by taking a different Condition.)
Conditions.PomocniczyOpis: You can also clear someone else’s Scared, Angry, Stressed, Jealous, or Embarrassed Condition by comforting or supporting them.The Injured, Hexed, or Unconscious Conditions can always be cleared in the hospital wing.
Conditions.FooterText: When all 8 Conditions are marked, roll +your highest trait to see if you exit the story..
Conditions.Result10: On a 10+: you come back with all Conditions cleared.
Conditions.Result79: On a 7-9: you come back with only Unconscious cleared..
Conditions.Result6: On a 6-: you exit the story. Create a new witch/wizard.
Conditions.ScarLabel: If you come back, you now have a physical or mental scar. Write it here:
Conditions.Fav2: Space for your second favourite subject (from Advancement)...
Conditions.SubOpis: You may add +1 to any roll related to your Favourite Subject.

PD.LuckOpis: When you want to do something you normally couldn't or change a roll to a 10+, you can mark a Luck point. You recover Luck at the end of the school year.
PD.ExpOpis: When you fail a roll, mark 1 point of Experience.When you get to 4 Experience, you may take an Advancement! Then, clear your marked Experience.
PD.AwansOpis: When you gain 4 XP or complete a school year, choose an Advancement:
PD.ZwiekszCeche: Upgrade a trait by +1. You may do this twice. No trait can ever be more than +3.
PD.UlubionyPrzedmiot: Gain a second Favourite Subject. You may do this once.
PD.NoweZaklecie: Learn a new spell from your Year. You may do this as many times as you’d like.
PD.MagicznyPrzedmiot: Aquire a magical object. You mays do this as many times as you’d like.
PD.OdzyskajSzczescie: Regain 1 marked point of Luck. You may do this as many times as you’d like.

Legend.Patronus: When you learn the Patronus Charm, pick your Patronus from the table on the Create Your Witch/Wizard Sheet.
Legend.Aportacja: You must pass a test and recieve a license from the Ministry of Magic to apparrate.
Legend.Portus: Making a portkey requires Ministry of Magic permission.
Legend.Stany2: A healing spell can clear the: Injured, Hexed or Unconscious Conditions, if the spell’s effect would heal the cause of the Condition.
Legend.Obronne: A defence spell can prevent someone from taking a Condition if the spell’s effect would block the cause of the Condition.
Legend.Hexeds: A hex can cause the Hexed Condition, in addition to the spell’s effect.
Legend.CursedS: A curse can cause the Injured or Unconscious, Conditions, in addition to the spell’s effect.
Legend.Nauka1: You can learn a spell from a class, a mentor, a book, or even from another student. If another student teaches you a spell, they must successfully roll to help someone.
Legend.Nauka2: You never have to roll to learn a spell or potion, unless the information on how to cast or concoct it is somehow hidden.
Legend.Nauka3: You immediately learn any spell taught in a classroom lesson, even if your 1st casting isn’t successful.
Legend.nieOpis: Unforgivable Curses cannot be learned at the start of play, by taking an Advancement, completing a school year, or from a class.
Legend.nieOpis2: When you cast an Unforgiveable Curse, the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens to you as a result.

Roll.SuccessDesc: Full success. Describe how you do it.
Roll.PartialDesc: Partial success. You succeed, but with a cost or complication.
Roll.FailureDesc: Failure. Mark 1 XP and prepare for consequences.

Match.lojalnosc: +Loyalty: your team is playing with great teamwork

Snitch.odwaga: +Bravery: your Seeker makes a daring maneuver to catch the Snitch
Snitch.spryt: +Cunning: your team sabotages the other Seeker to catch the Snitch
Snitch.intelekt: +Intellect: your team outwits the other Seeker to catch the Snitch
Snitch.lojalnosc: +Loyalty: a teammate helps your Seeker catch the Snitch

UI.FriendOption: +1: the person you help or hinder is your Friend or Rival
UI.SubjectOption: +1: roll related to your Favourite Subject
UI.ShiftHint: Tip: Shift+click a trait to roll without this window.
UI.XpFull: You may take an Advancement, then clear your marked Experience!
UI.XpAlreadyFull: All 4 Experience points are already marked: take an Advancement, then clear your Experience.
UI.SpendLuck: Mark a point of Luck to change the result to 10+
UI.LuckSpent: {name} marks a point of Luck: the result becomes 10+!
UI.LuckAlreadyUsed: Luck has already been used for this roll.
UI.NotOwner: You do not control this character.
UI.UnknownSpell: {name} doesn’t know “{spell}”. Mark a point of Luck to try anyway?
UI.UnknownNoLuck: You don’t know “{spell}” and have no Luck left.
UI.LuckForUnknown: Luck point marked: unknown spell or potion.
UI.Mastered: “{spell}” was learned two or more Years ago: you can always cast it without rolling, unless you’re in a stressful situation (Shift+click to roll).
UI.SpellsHelp: Tick the spells you know. Click a name to cast it (or concoct the potion): unknown spell = 1 Luck point; spell from two or more Years ago = success without a roll (Shift+click to roll).
UI.ExitPrompt: {name} has marked all 8 Conditions! Roll +your highest trait to see if you exit the story.
UI.ScarReminder: You now have a physical or mental scar: write it on your sheet.
UI.ItemsHelp: Drop objects from the compendium here; click a name to use it.
UI.Points5: 5 – simple things (right answer in class / not paying attention)
UI.Points10: 10 – minor things (clever homework / late to class)
UI.Points20: 20 – significant things (disobeying a teacher, out after curfew)
UI.StartPointsConfirm: Roll 1d6 for each House on the non-player character points table (250 to 375)? Current points will be replaced.
UI.EndSessionMsg:
• Each player may write down or erase Friends and Rivals.
  • Players with 4 Experience take an Advancement.
  • Are there new Mysteries to write down, or solved Mysteries to cross off?
  • Update your Threats.
UI.EndYearConfirm: All main characters regain all their Luck points.
UI.AdvanceYear: Move students up to the next Year
UI.EndYearMsg: The school year is over: every witch and wizard regains all their Luck and takes an Advancement. Don’t forget to award the House Cup and the Quidditch Cup!

stan-w-obliczu.name: STAND IN THE FACE OF DANGER
stan-w-obliczu.success:
On a 10+, pick one:
• You stand firm and nobody gets hurt.
• You aren’t hurt, and you hurt the threat right back.
stan-w-obliczu.compromise:
On a 7-9, pick one:
• You hurt the threat, but it hurts you as well.
• You aren’t able to act, but the threat backs off.
• You flee, but you don’t suffer any Serious Consequences.
• You avoid Serious Consequences, but someone else suffers them instead.
stan-w-obliczu.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. You aren’t able to face the danger, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

zdobadz-czego-szukasz.name: GET WHAT YOU SEEK
zdobadz-czego-szukasz.success: On a 10+, you get what you wanted, no problem.
zdobadz-czego-szukasz.compromise:
On a 7-9, you get what you wanted, but (pick one)...
• The person you got it from is suspicious.
• You must give or promise something in return.
• The person you got it from changes their attitude towards you.
zdobadz-czego-szukasz.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. You don’t get what you wanted, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

pomoz-lub-przeszkodz.name: HELP OR HINDER SOMEONE
pomoz-lub-przeszkodz.success:
FOR OTHER MAIN CHARACTERS
On a 10+, pick one:
• Give them +/-1 to their roll.
• Prevent them from taking a Condition.
• Offer them 1 Experience to stop what they’re doing.

FOR NARRATOR CHARACTERS
On a 10+, you help or hinder them as you want.
pomoz-lub-przeszkodz.compromise:
FOR OTHER MAIN CHARACTERS
On a 7-9, pick one of the above options, but take a Condition as a result of your efforts.

FOR NARRATOR CHARACTERS
On a 7-9, you help or hinder them, but (pick one)...
• You take a Condition in the process.
• They’re accidentally hurt in the process.
• They are upset with you for doing so.
• They are suspicious of your motives.
pomoz-lub-przeszkodz.failure:
FOR OTHER PLAYER CHARACTERS
On a 6-, mark an Experience point. You cannot help or hinder them, and the GM may describe serious consequences that result.

FOR NON-PLAYER CHARACTERS (GM)
On a 6-, mark an Experience point. You cannot help or hinder them, and the GM may describe serious consequences that result.

zbliz-sie-stworzenie.name: APPROACH A MAGICAL CREATURE
zbliz-sie-stworzenie.success: On a 10+, the creature acts as you want.
zbliz-sie-stworzenie.compromise:
On a 7-9, pick one:
• The creature acts as you want, but you take a Condition for your efforts.
• The creature acts as you want, but it attracts unwanted attention.
• The creature doesn't act as you want, but it does something else helpful.
zbliz-sie-stworzenie.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. The creature goes wild, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

ukryj-sie.name: HIDE & SNEAK
ukryj-sie.success: On a 10+, you or whatever you’re hiding aren’t detected.
ukryj-sie.compromise:
On a 7-9, pick one:
• Someone or something is looking for you or what you’ve hidden.
• Someone or something knows you’re here or that you’ve hidden something, but not where.
• You leave some kind of trace or evidence behind.
ukryj-sie.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. You or whatever you’re hiding are found, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

zdobadz-wiedze.name: GAIN KNOWLEDGE
zdobadz-wiedze.success:
On a 10+, you gain the knowledge you wanted. You may ask the Narrator a question and they must give a true answer.
You might ask:
• What here isn’t what it seems to be?
• Where is the thing I’m looking for?
• What’s the history of this?
• How do I make this useful?
• Are they telling the truth?
• What do they really want?
• What do I remember about this?
zdobadz-wiedze.compromise:
On a 7-9, you get some of the knowledge you wanted. You may ask the Narrator a question. They must give you a true answer, but they don’t have to give you a full answer.
You might ask:
• What here isn’t what it seems to be?
• Where is the thing I’m looking for?
• What’s the history of this?
• How do I make this useful?
• Are they telling the truth?
• What do they really want?
• What do I remember about this?
zdobadz-wiedze.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. You’re not sure if you got the knowledge you wanted. You may ask the Narrator a question, but they don’t have to give you a full answer, or a true one. The Narrator may also tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

rzuc-zaklecie.name: CAST A SPELL
rzuc-zaklecie.success: On a 10+, you successfully cast the spell the way you wanted.
rzuc-zaklecie.compromise:
On a 7-9, you successfully cast the spell, but (pick one)...
• The effect isn’t as powerful as it should be.
• The effect doesn’t last as long as it should.
• You attract unwanted attention.
rzuc-zaklecie.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. You fail to cast the spell, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

pojedynek.name: DUEL
pojedynek.success: On a 10+, your spell hits the other witch/wizard, and their spell misses!
pojedynek.compromise:
On a 7-9, pick one:
• Your spells collide in midair!
• Your spell misses, but so does theirs!
• Both spells hit!
pojedynek.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. Your spell misses, and their spell hits! The Narrator tells you a Serious Consequence that happens to you as a result.

uwarz-eliksir.name: CONCOCT A POTION
uwarz-eliksir.success: On a 10+, you correctly create the potion you wanted.
uwarz-eliksir.compromise:
On a 7-9, you create the potion, but (pick one)...
• It has some unintended side effect.
• The process goes wonky and you take a Condition.
• You accidentally make a different potion (the Narrator tells you which one).
uwarz-eliksir.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. You don’t create the potion successfully, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

uzyj-obiektu.name: USE A MAGICAL OBJECT
uzyj-obiektu.success: On a 10+, the object works exactly as expected and you make full use of it.
uzyj-obiektu.compromise:
On a 7-9, pick one:
• The object does something unexpected but helpful.
• The object’s effect isn’t as powerful as it should be.
• The object works as expected, but you take a Condition from using it.
• The object works, but it breaks in the process.
uzyj-obiektu.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. The magical object doesn’t work correctly, and the Narrator may tell you a Serious Consequence that happens as a result.

mecz-quidditcha.name: PLAY A QUIDDITCH MATCH
mecz-quidditcha.success: On a 10+, you keep control of the match and your team scores 10 points!
mecz-quidditcha.compromise:
On a 7-9, neither team scores and you pass control of the match to the person to your left. Your team doesn’t get a goal because (pick one)...
• Someone on your team misses a throw or a catch!
• Someone on your team is hit by a Bludger!
• Your team’s play doesn’t go as planned!
• The other team pulls a trick play!
mecz-quidditcha.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience and pass control to the person to your left. Your team doesn’t score, and the Narrator describes how the other team scores 10 points. They may also tell you a Serious Consequence that occurs as a result of your attempt.

zloty-znicz.name: CATCH THE GOLDEN SNITCH
zloty-znicz.success: On a 10+, you do it! Your team catches the Golden Snitch and ends the match, giving your team 150 points.
zloty-znicz.compromise: On a 7-9, your team isn’t able to catch the Golden Snitch, but neither is the other team. Pass control of the match to the person to your left.
zloty-znicz.failure: On a 6-, mark a point of Experience. Your team fails to catch the Golden Snitch, and the other team gets it for 150 points. The Narrator may also tell you a Serious Consequence that occurs as a result of your attempt.
